experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted trial 0 values: {"advice_slice_hits": 1, "advice_w16_is_g": 1, "advice_w17": 1, "classes": 728, "fibre": 1019866814, "fibre_dfs_ops": 1944, "fibre_shift": 97451488, "g16_fibre_size": 2, "g17_fibre_size": 1, "groups": 200, "ops_per_cand": 411, "sample_trail": 200, "sample_valid": 200, "sample_w16_one_value": 1, "sample_w9_shifted": 200, "sfs_collision": 1}. experiments.scope: Advice collision and construction checks (fibres, inversion, 256-candidate slice); for one entry of each of the 200 groups at the advice point: the rule, W9 = advice W9 + 0x05cefde0, one W16 value, the two-message trail through step 16. No claw of the advice itself (it is not on the fibre). Not an ordinary fixed-IV certificate.

experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r39joint_k4.py._k4e on the organizer seeds of trials 0-3, windows run with the screen off (screen=0; the k4 path is the same code with the screen on): (claws, F9, 0, pass lanes, survivors, key hits, k4 ops, total ops) = (233,7,0,436800,2,0,1019221,11504962), (222,11,0,624000,5,0,1454268,13875066), (256,4,0,249600,2,0,584630,13031225), (232,1,0,62400,0,0,144113,11245985) (K4_WIN_EXP); k4 ops = evaluated F9 claws (pass lanes / 62,400) x (143,633 + 480) + 12 per repeated F9 claw + the counted cost of real survivors (711 + 563 per class tested); every F9 claw asserts W9 = C9 + 0x05cefde0 - a1 = W9 of a listed entry and W16 = g; pass-off identity on trials 0 and 1; for the first F9 claw of each trial and each of the 200 groups a planted key is found and its cost asserted ('k4 plant'); k4_setup = 1,107,473,556. Key dispersion over all entries of groups 0, 50, 100, 150: per F9 claw D = keys with an entry in F8, K = those with W17 x 2654435761 mod 2^32 top 7 bits zero; K ~ Binomial(D, 2^-7) under independence. Accept if sum D >= 96,821, |sum K - sum D/128| within 2.576 s.d., Pearson < 40.29 (22 dof). Asserted per trial (sum D, sum K, Pearson, claws): (59,256, 437, 6.5188, 7); (67,492, 518, 7.9839, 10); (17,882, 142, 0.7772, 4); (1,872, 7, 4.0067, 1). Screened window (trial 0, same seed, screen on as on the attack path): asserted not skipped, kept chaining value with S <= 5, every first-block draw charged 187 operations (kept) or 190 (discarded), and the discarded-draw count equal to the number of draws with S > 5 (12 draws, 11 discarded, kept S = 1); no new output key.
experiments.scope: Trials 0 to 3 run 4 windows of 2^21 walk evaluations of the shipped program, k4 and check mode on. On every F9 claw the counted W17 pass runs over all 62,400 prefix lanes of the 200 groups; planted checks and the diagnostic then run with the counter restored; the list is generated at import by rule and asserted by its counts; trials 0 and 1 are re-run with k4 off; trial 0 also runs one window with the a3eb4a8a screen on.
